# Axiom Church

> A place you can stop pretending. Axiom Church is a non-denominational church in Leander, Texas, for people who thought they would never step foot in one. Sundays at 10 AM at Camacho Elementary, 501 Municipal Dr, Leander, TX 78641. About 65 minutes. Phone 512-265-5718.

Axiom serves Leander, Cedar Park, Liberty Hill, North Austin, Round Rock, and Georgetown. Cedar Park and Liberty Hill are about 15 minutes away; Round Rock, Georgetown, and North Austin about 25. The service is casual: a few songs and a Bible teaching. No dress code. Kids birth through 5th grade go to Axiom Kids during the service, with background-checked volunteers and matching pickup tags.
